# assoc.minsens { #polars_corpus.assoc.minsens }

```python
assoc.minsens(f12, f1, f2, n)
```

Compute minimum sensitivity values for contingency table data.

Calculates the minimum sensitivity (minimum of precision and recall)
as an association measure between two categorical variables. This metric
represents the smaller of the two conditional probabilities: P(y|x) and P(x|y).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|--------|----------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| f12    | IntoExprColumn | Joint frequencies of variable pairs. Can be a column name (str) or Polars expression.                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
| f1     | IntoExprColumn | Marginal frequencies of first variable. Can be a column name (str) or Polars expression.                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
| f2     | IntoExprColumn | Marginal frequencies of second variable. Can be a column name (str) or Polars expression.                                                                                                                     | _required_ |
| n      | IntoExprColumn | Grand total (total number of observations). Can be a column name (str) or Polars expression. Note: This parameter is not used in the calculation but is kept for consistency with other association measures. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type    | Description                                                                              |
|--------|---------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pl.Expr | A Polars expression that computes the minimum sensitivity values for each variable pair. |

## Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

Minimum sensitivity is calculated as:

.. math::
    \text{min_sens}(x,y) = \min\left(\frac{f_{12}}{f_1}, \frac{f_{12}}{f_2}\right)

This corresponds to:

.. math::
    \text{min_sens}(x,y) = \min(P(y|x), P(x|y))

where:

- f₁₂/f₁ represents the precision: P(y|x)
- f₁₂/f₂ represents the recall: P(x|y)
